query: Simular las ventas diarias de una plataforma de comercio electrónico en expansión durante un año. Dominio: Retail y Ventas. Variable estricta: Únicamente 'Ventas_Diarias'. Perfil matemático: P3_TENDENCIA_ESTACIONAL, con tendencia creciente sostenida y ciclos semanales marcados por mayor consumo en fines de semana. Escala: promedio inicial de 2500 USD creciendo hacia 4000 USD.

values.tema: Daily sales of an e-commerce platform during a year

structured_prompt.justification: The time series represents the daily sales of an e-commerce platform during a year. The sales are expected to show a growing trend with a weekly cycle, as sales tend to be higher on weekends. The sample rate is daily, and the duration is one year.
structured_prompt.suggested_search: Time series analysis of e-commerce sales data
structured_prompt.search_strategy: Search for articles and research papers on time series analysis of e-commerce sales data, focusing on the impact of external events such as holidays and weekends.
